answer: Stop sybils with hardware-rooted liveness pulses. First, an agent registers one TPM enclave key — one chip, one identity. Second, every six hours the network sends a random challenge to sign inside the enclave within 30 seconds, a pulse no script can fake. Third, a missed pulse freezes trading, and a duplicate key burns the agent's $100 bond and revokes it. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 TPM chips at $40 each plus $1,000,000 in bonds: $1,400,000 and a warehouse no farm can conjure. Like a quill tracing one plume of smoke to a single fire, each signature traces to one chip.
